integrity: The proofs of switching normal form, path-chain descent, quotient geometry, and residual homological action are included. The standalone checker independently corroborates 22 cubical and 12 low-degree signed GLMY cases; these finite checks are not a proof of all degrees.
scientific_limitations: Real coefficients and square-flat edge signings on Cartesian products of cycles of length at least five; no assertion for arbitrary signs, integral torsion or all graph products.
title: Flat-holonomy vanishing for signed path homology of discrete tori
